svg.title: Technology stack and communication interfaces of the prototype implementation.
svg.desc: A demonstration interface sends HTTP and JSON to a FastAPI backend. LLM intent processing is followed by deterministic intent validation and graph-based verification. Parameterized Cypher queries connect the verifier to Neo4j. An independent knowledge synchronization pipeline updates Neo4j from official Aave and Uniswap sources and blockchain RPC and factory events. The Python backend stores the approved operation and performs graph re-verification before invoking Node.js. Node.js, viem and the ZeroDev SDK use a Kernel Smart Account, ECDSA Validator and ERC-4337 EntryPoint v0.7 for transaction submission to Ethereum Sepolia, chain ID 11155111.
